risk_banner.text: RISK, CH FADER (fig 3-2, CC 17-20 ch 5): the XDJ-AZ MIDI list prints "Upper Side=0, Lower Side=127"; the app map assumes lower = 0. Before the set, pull one channel fader fully DOWN and confirm that channel goes silent in the app. Hover any box for its MIDI wire; labels read [deck 1/3] left, [deck 2/4] right.
